author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for CATACOMBOS, a physics-based roguelike about meme cats fighting against hordes of dogs. Players throw cats onto the battlefield, merging them into stronger and crazier versions, and building different combinations to survive increasingly chaotic waves of dog enemies. Discover new cats, hats, items, and spells as you restore the missing pages of a mysterious ancient journal. Uncover every secret hidden within the world of CATACOMBOS! 

CATACOMBOS is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: CATACOMBOS - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Nortopia, a cozy idle colony sim developed by SQRT Games. In Nortopia, you build a civilization of penguins and automate every process until your colony can thrive without your direct involvement. The penguins escaped a land plagued by disease and the undead. Now the island of Nortopia offers them a chance to begin again. Take the role of their leader, plan the settlement, provide everything the colony needs, and turn an empty shore into a safe and welcoming home. Nortopia is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Nortopia - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Endless Isolation, a classic survival horror game developed by WhiteShine Games. A regular post-shift evening at Viralith Corporation turns into a nightmare when you wake up on an isolated island swarming with monsters. With limited ammunition and ruthless enemies, you have to decide when to fight and when to run. Endless Isolation is planned to launch in September 2026 on PC (Steam).
title: Endless Isolation - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for Confession of Murder, a first-person psychological horror game developed by birparaq_team. Play as a detective investigating a series of murders in a small town, aided by a mysterious walkie-talkie. Explore crime scenes, search for clues, and interrogate witnesses. Behind each crime is a mysterious killer who leaves behind more and more questions. Confession of Murder is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Confession of Murder - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Genshin Impact story teaser trailer for the action RPG. Genshin Impact is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.

The official trailer description reads: "Warmth and cold can stem from the very same memory, waiting for a heart willing to embrace it. Songs and dances may come to an end, but she will never stop moving forward."
title: Genshin Impact - Official 'Embers Beneath the Ice' Story Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Arcfactory, an open-world survival sim developed by SadMofrog. Journey to the center of an ancient station, where the star itself is rumored to be locked away. Explore the open world of this massive megastructure, where each location has its own unique effects and features, and build automated factories to fight against a living and realigning station. Arcfactory is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Arcfactory - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at a developer arcade-style match featuring Duck King vs Terry Bogard. 
Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Duck King vs Terry Bogard Arcade-Style Match

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Before Crisis Chapter 2: Turks Offensive Trailer for Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis, the free-to-play turn-based action-adventure RPG developed by Applibot and Square Enix. Players will learn more about the Turks in this new chapter of the three-part series. Before Crisis Chapter 2: Turks Offensive is launching on August 5 for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis - Official Before Crisis Chapter 2: Turks Offensive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Before Crisis Chapter 3: Turks Encirclement trailer for Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis, the free-to-play turn-based action-adventure RPG developed by Applibot and Square Enix. This new chapter brings final story updates related to the Turks operatives in the three-part series. Before Crisis Chapter 3: Turks Encirclement is launching August 26 for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis - Official Before Crisis Chapter 3: Turks Encirclement
